title: Edge delivery and content delivery networks (CDN)
summary: A Content Delivery Network (CDN) moves static and cacheable responses closer to users so latency drops and origin load shrinks. Amazon CloudFront is AWS's global CDN: distributions, origins, cache behaviors, Origin Access Control (OAC) for private Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3) buckets, and fronting API Gateway or Application Load Balancer (ALB) for hybrid static-plus-API traffic. Learn cache keys, Time To Live (TTL), invalidation, signed URLs, and the production tradeoffs senior interviews probe.
